answer: Standing comes only from clients who forge a signed stake: three distinct clients each lock 50 credits, and one stake cannot back a second identity. Those stakes weave a trellis; losing one cuts weight by a third. A sparrow auditor checks payment history, rejecting stakes with no verified payment. The kth fake still needs three new clients and 150 credits, so 1,000 fakes need 3,000 clients and 150,000 credits. Renting clients fails because the renter risks 50 credits and the sparrow check exposes empty history, forfeiting the stake. An honest agent needs three clients and 150 credits once.
